stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the underlined word.
The clerk was DILIGENT in sorting the applications.
explanation: Diligent means showing steady, careful effort, so hardworking is the closest meaning.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the capitalized word.
The instructions were AMBIGUOUS, so many applicants filled out the form incorrectly.
explanation: Ambiguous means open to more than one interpretation, or unclear. That explains why applicants made mistakes.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the capitalized word.
The agency issued a TEMPORARY permit while the main application was processed.
explanation: Temporary means lasting for a limited time. Provisional means arranged for the present, possibly to be changed later.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the capitalized word.
The official tried to MITIGATE the effects of the flood on the evacuees.
explanation: To mitigate is to make something less severe, so lessen is the closest meaning.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the capitalized word.
Her CANDID remarks during the meeting surprised the panel.
explanation: Candid means truthful and straightforward, or frank. Rude adds an insult that candid does not carry.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the capitalized word.
The new policy will SUPERSEDE the old guidelines.
explanation: To supersede is to take the place of something older, so replace is the closest meaning.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the capitalized word.
The report was so VERBOSE that the main point was hard to find.
explanation: Verbose means using more words than needed, or wordy.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the capitalized word.
The barangay captain was known for his PRUDENT use of funds.
explanation: Prudent means acting with care and good judgment, especially about the future, so careful is the closest meaning.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the capitalized word.
The office has an ADEQUATE supply of forms for the month.
explanation: Adequate means enough for a requirement, or sufficient.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the capitalized word.
The witness gave a LUCID account of the incident.
explanation: Lucid means expressed clearly and easy to understand.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the capitalized word.
The committee was criticized for its PERFUNCTORY review of the complaints.
explanation: Perfunctory describes something done only as a routine duty, with little care or effort. Superficial is the closest meaning.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the capitalized word.
The two agencies decided to COLLABORATE on the vaccination drive.
explanation: To collaborate is to work jointly with others, or to cooperate.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the capitalized word.
The mayor's speech was full of ERUDITE references to history.
explanation: Erudite means having or showing great knowledge or learning, so scholarly is the closest meaning.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the capitalized word.
The employee was COMMENDED for returning the lost wallet.
explanation: To commend is to praise formally or officially.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the capitalized word.
The road project was put on hold due to INSUFFICIENT funds.
explanation: Insufficient means not enough, or inadequate. Missing would mean entirely absent.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the capitalized word.
The auditor found the explanation SPECIOUS and asked for supporting documents.
explanation: Specious means seeming reasonable or true on the surface but actually wrong, or misleadingly plausible.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the capitalized word.
The residents were RELUCTANT to leave their homes despite the warning.
explanation: Reluctant means unwilling and hesitant. Unable would mean they lacked the ability, which is a different idea.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the capitalized word.
Please VERIFY the applicant's documents before approval.
explanation: To verify is to make sure something is true or accurate, or to confirm.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the capitalized word.
The official remained IMPARTIAL throughout the hearing.
explanation: Impartial means treating all sides equally, without bias, or neutral.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the capitalized word.
The typhoon caused EXTENSIVE damage to crops in the region.
explanation: Extensive means covering a large area or wide range, or widespread.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the capitalized word.
The director's EPHEMERAL popularity faded after a few months.
explanation: Ephemeral means lasting a very short time, which matches popularity that faded within months.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the capitalized word.
The teacher's EXPLICIT instructions left no room for confusion.
explanation: Explicit means stated clearly and in detail, leaving no room for confusion.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the capitalized word.
The new system made the processing of permits more EFFICIENT.
explanation: Efficient means achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort or expense.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the capitalized word.
The spokesperson gave an EQUIVOCAL answer to avoid committing to a date.
explanation: Equivocal means open to more than one interpretation, often deliberately vague. An evasive answer avoids committing, as described.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the capitalized word.
The newly hired staff were ENTHUSIASTIC about their first assignment.
explanation: Enthusiastic means showing intense and eager enjoyment or interest.

stem:
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the capitalized word.
The line at the cashier was moving at a RAPID pace.
explanation: Rapid means fast; its opposite is slow. Quick is a synonym, not an antonym.

stem:
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the capitalized word.
The hall was CROWDED during the job fair.
explanation: Crowded means full of people; its opposite is empty.

stem:
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the capitalized word.
The supervisor's response to the complaint was HOSTILE.
explanation: Hostile means unfriendly or antagonistic; its opposite is friendly.

stem:
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the capitalized word.
The committee gave its UNANIMOUS approval.
explanation: Unanimous means fully agreed by everyone; the opposite is divided.

stem:
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the capitalized word.
The city's budget showed a large DEFICIT this year.
explanation: A deficit is an amount by which spending exceeds income; its opposite is a surplus. Loss, debt and shortage are all close in meaning to deficit.

stem:
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the capitalized word.
The new procedure is VOLUNTARY for all employees.
explanation: Voluntary means done by choice; its opposite is compulsory, meaning required.

stem:
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the capitalized word.
The officer gave a VAGUE description of the suspect.
explanation: Vague means unclear or imprecise; its opposite is precise.

stem:
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the capitalized word.
His FRUGAL habits helped him save for a house.
explanation: Frugal means sparing or economical with money; its opposite is extravagant. Thrifty is a synonym.

stem:
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the capitalized word.
The evidence against the accused was CONCLUSIVE.
explanation: Conclusive means settling an issue decisively; its opposite is inconclusive. The other choices are near-synonyms.

stem:
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the capitalized word.
The speaker's tone was CONCILIATORY.
explanation: Conciliatory means intended to calm or make peace; its opposite is antagonistic.

stem:
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the capitalized word.
The client's request was ACCEPTED by the office.
explanation: Accepted is the opposite of rejected.

stem:
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the capitalized word.
The weather in the mountains is usually MILD in December.
explanation: Mild weather is gentle and not extreme; the opposite is harsh.

stem:
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the capitalized word.
The plan was criticized as being too RIGID.
explanation: Rigid means unable to bend or change; its opposite is flexible.

stem:
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the capitalized word.
The population of the town has been INCREASING.
explanation: Increasing means growing; its opposite is declining. Stable means neither increasing nor decreasing, so it is not the opposite.

stem:
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the capitalized word.
The witness was RETICENT when asked about the incident.
explanation: Reticent means not revealing one's thoughts readily; its opposite is talkative. Reserved is a synonym.

stem:
Complete the analogy.
PEN : WRITE :: KNIFE : ___
explanation: A pen is used to write; a knife is used to cut. The relationship is tool to function.

stem:
Complete the analogy.
DOCTOR : HOSPITAL :: TEACHER : ___
explanation: A doctor works in a hospital; a teacher works in a school. The relationship is worker to workplace.

stem:
Complete the analogy.
PUPPY : DOG :: KITTEN : ___
explanation: A puppy is a young dog; a kitten is a young cat.

stem:
Complete the analogy.
HOT : COLD :: ANCIENT : ___
explanation: Hot and cold are opposites; the opposite of ancient is modern.

stem:
Complete the analogy.
PAGE : BOOK :: BRICK : ___
explanation: A page is a part of a book; a brick is a part of a wall. The relationship is part to whole.

stem:
Complete the analogy.
THERMOMETER : TEMPERATURE :: ODOMETER : ___
explanation: A thermometer measures temperature; an odometer measures distance traveled. A speedometer measures speed.

stem:
Complete the analogy.
AUTHOR : NOVEL :: COMPOSER : ___
explanation: An author creates a novel; a composer creates a symphony. The relationship is creator to creation.

stem:
Complete the analogy.
DROUGHT : WATER :: FAMINE : ___
explanation: A drought is a severe shortage of water; a famine is a severe shortage of food. Hunger is a result of famine, not the thing lacking.

stem:
Complete the analogy.
FINGER : HAND :: TOE : ___
explanation: A finger is part of a hand; a toe is part of a foot.

stem:
Complete the analogy.
BENEVOLENT : KIND :: MALEVOLENT : ___
explanation: Benevolent means kind; malevolent means wishing harm, or wicked. Each pair is word to synonym.

stem:
Complete the analogy.
CAPTAIN : SHIP :: PILOT : ___
explanation: A captain commands a ship; a pilot flies an airplane. The relationship is operator to vehicle.

stem:
Complete the analogy.
SCARCE : ABUNDANT :: TIMID : ___
explanation: Scarce and abundant are opposites; the opposite of timid is bold.

stem:
Complete the analogy.
SEED : TREE :: EGG : ___
explanation: A seed grows into a tree; an egg develops into a bird. The relationship is beginning stage to mature form.

stem:
Complete the analogy.
LIBRARIAN : BOOKS :: CURATOR : ___
explanation: A librarian manages and cares for books; a curator manages and cares for a collection of artifacts or exhibits, as in a museum.

stem:
Complete the analogy.
HUNGRY : EAT :: TIRED : ___
explanation: When hungry, one eats to satisfy the need; when tired, one rests. Yawning is a symptom of tiredness, not what relieves it.
